navigation.navHostNote: Single NavHost, no global Scaffold. 'main' route hosts a 4-page HorizontalPager (Retrospective=0, Dashboard=1, Journal=2, Settings=3) with BottomNavBar; initialTab default=2 (Journal). The 4 main screens are reachable only via swipe/bottom-nav inside 'main', NOT as separate nav routes.

screens.name: SplashScreen
screens.purpose: Branding splash; routes to Consent / Onboarding / Main based on first-run + consent-shown + onboarding-completed prefs.

screens.name: ConsentScreen
screens.purpose: Granular DSGVO consent (analytics, Groq, Gemini, Edge-TTS toggles, default OFF) with links to legal docs; provable timestamp+policy-version persisted.

screens.name: LegalDocumentScreen
screens.purpose: Renders one of three legal documents (privacy policy, terms, imprint) with back nav.

screens.name: OnboardingScreen
screens.purpose: Goal-selection onboarding; saves goals to prefs for paywall personalization; marks onboarding completed.

screens.name: RetrospectiveScreen
screens.purpose: Weekly/monthly/yearly AI-generated retrospectives with photo collage; review gated behind paywall (source=review_locked).

screens.name: DashboardScreen
screens.purpose: AI entropy analysis dashboard: category advice blocks, top-5 actions, scenario switching, manual refresh limit (3); paywall sources weekly_review/first_analysis/free_limit. OVERSIZE 193KB.

screens.name: JournalScreen
screens.purpose: Core journal: voice recording -> Groq transcription -> Gemini text improvement -> save entry; entry list; streaks/achievements; opens EntryDetail and Paywall.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Settings hub: profile/sign-in, theme, reminders, biometric lock, Drive backup (photos/videos), PDF export, custom analyses, consent revoke, subscription mgmt/churn, legal links, crisis help. OVERSIZE 289KB.

screens.name: EntryDetailScreen
screens.purpose: View/edit a journal entry: original vs AI-improved text, photos, follow-ups (Nachtraege), re-improve/summarize/analyze AI actions, delete, share; paywall source nachtrag_upsell.

screens.name: PaywallScreen
screens.purpose: Premium subscription paywall (monthly/yearly/lifetime via Google Play Billing); headline personalized by onboarding goal; source param tracks trigger origin for analytics.

dialogs: ~8 AlertDialogs incl. AdviceDerivationDialog (how advice was derived)
PrivacyPreferencesSheet (ModalBottomSheet, granular consent incl. do-not-sell for en-US)

viewModels.name: SplashViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Reads consent-shown & onboarding-completed prefs to decide start route.

viewModels.name: ConsentViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Holds granular consent toggles (analytics/Groq/Gemini/TTS); persists choices + audit timestamp via prefs & PrivacyGateHelper; injects FirebaseAnalytics.

viewModels.name: OnboardingViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Tracks selected goals, saves goals + onboarding-completed flag; fires analytics events.

viewModels.name: JournalViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Recording state machine (IDLE->RECORDING->TRANSCRIBING->IMPROVING->PREVIEW->SAVING); orchestrates audio record + Groq transcription + Gemini improve + save; streaks/achievements; AI tiered-access checks.

viewModels.name: EntryDetailViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Loads/edits one entry, photos, follow-ups; AI improve/summarize/analyze with rate-limiter; delete + share; Drive sync.

viewModels.name: DashboardViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: AI entropy analysis + advice generation; manual-refresh limit (3); scenario/custom-profile switching; AI usage tracking + tiered access; auto-update toggle.

viewModels.name: RetrospectiveViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Weekly/monthly/yearly summaries from repository; generates retrospectives via use case; photo collage; billing-gated; waits for Drive restore.

viewModels.name: SettingsViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: All settings state: profile/auth, theme, reminder, biometric lock, Drive backup (photos/videos), PDF export, subscription/churn, consent revoke; injects 3 DAOs + DriveBackupManager + DailyReminderManager + PdfExporter.

viewModels.name: PaywallViewModel
viewModels.responsibility: Subscription prices (monthly/yearly/lifetime) from BillingManager; personalizes headline by onboarding goal; tracks paywall source for analytics.

sensitiveFields: summaryText (AI summary of personal diary periods)

useCases: RecordAudioUseCase: wraps AudioRecorderHelper - start/stop mic recording, expose amplitude+duration.
TranscribeAudioUseCase: speech-to-text via TranscriptionRepository (Groq Whisper, api.groq.com).
ImproveTextUseCase: rewrites diary text via FirebaseAiService (Gemini); chunks long text; locale-aware prompt.
SummarizeEntryUseCase: AI summary/title for an entry+follow-ups via FirebaseAiService (Gemini), retries.
AnalyzeEntropyUseCase: runs AI entropy analysis over all entries via AdviceRepository; tier/rate-limited (cost control).
GenerateAdviceUseCase: exposes Flow of advice blocks from AdviceRepository (local cache).
GenerateRetrospectiveUseCase: AI weekly/monthly/yearly retrospectives via FirebaseAiService (Gemini), concurrent w/ Semaphore.
SaveJournalEntryUseCase: persists a JournalEntry via JournalRepository (Room).
SignInWithGoogleUseCase: Google sign-in/sign-out + stored profile via AuthRepository (Credential Manager).
SyncWithDriveUseCase: zips DB+custom-analyses, backup/restore/merge to Google Drive; consent-gated (NeedConsentException).
SyncProgressHolder: singleton StateFlow exposing Drive upload/download progress across ViewModels (helper, not a UseCase).
repositories: JournalRepository: CRUD for journal entries (Room JournalEntryDao).
PhotoRepository: manage entry photos/videos (file paths + EntryPhotoDao).
AdviceRepository: advice/dashboard blocks + entropy analysis cache (AdviceDashboardDao).
AuthRepository: Google sign-in state + stored UserProfile (Credential Manager).
TranscriptionRepository: audio->text via Groq Whisper API (returns TranscriptionResult).

diExternalServices.module: AppModule - NOTE: EncryptedSharedPreferences+MasterKeys is DEPRECATED API

backgroundJobs.name: DailyReminderManager
backgroundJobs.purpose: Daily journaling reminder notification at user-set hour/minute. NO WorkManager in project.

backgroundJobs.name: Drive sync (SyncWithDriveUseCase)
backgroundJobs.purpose: Backup/restore encrypted DB+photos+videos to user's Google Drive.

criticalObservations: ALL local user data is highly sensitive personal-diary content: raw + AI-improved diary text, mood tags, follow-ups, AI psychological entropy analysis & advice, photos AND videos (file paths), and AI period-summaries. This is GDPR Art.9-adjacent (mental-health/emotional data) - central to the rechtssicherheit audit.
Three separate Room DBs (AppDatabase, DashboardDatabase, RetrospectiveDatabase) - all local, no server copy of diary content; only subscription status goes to a Firebase Function (europe-west1).

Cloud AI processing of diary content: text is sent to Groq (api.groq.com, US-based) for transcription and to Firebase/Gemini for improve/summarize/analyze/retrospective. Each cloud service is gated by granular consent (ConsentScreen + per-use PrivacyGateDialog, default OFF). Marketing/privacy claims must match: Groq is a US processor; Gemini via Firebase AI.

Paywall is reachable from 5 screens with 10 distinct source values (limit_reached, weekly_review, first_analysis, free_limit, review_locked, custom_analyses_limit, churn_yearly_switch, settings_tap, pdf_export, nachtrag_upsell) - relevant for UWG/feature-claim mapping of which features are premium-gated.

Subscription cancellation has a dedicated multi-step ChurnFlowDialog with a retention offer (Overview->Reason->RetentionOffer->Confirm) - check it does not constitute a dark pattern / make cancellation harder than signup (EU UCPD, BGH).

CrisisHelpDialog provides emergency mental-health phone/web links - supports the sensitive-data classification and any 'this app is not medical advice' disclaimer obligations (AiLimitsDisclaimer present).
EncryptedSharedPreferences + MasterKeys (deprecated security-crypto API) is the secrets/prefs store - works but flagged for future migration to DataStore+Tink (Android rule).
plugin_bugs_observed: Worker cwd reset to ~/proggs between Bash calls (NOT the app root given in the briefing): the first tool batch using relative 'app/src/main/java' failed with 'Path does not exist'. Recommendation: orchestrator should inject ABSOLUTE paths into the worker prompt examples, or worker must always prefix BestJournalAndroid/. Cost one round-trip.

Inline heredoc (<< 'PYEOF') with a large Python script containing an apostrophe (the word user's) failed with bash 'unexpected EOF while looking for matching quote' - the surrounding Bash-tool quoting interacted badly with the heredoc. Robust fix: Write the Python to a .py file then run it, instead of inline heredoc. This is the recurring 100%-match bug-case for this worker class.

OVERSIZE-rule (FIN-048) worked as intended: Grep with -C/head_limit + Python head-slices on SettingsScreen.kt (289KB) and DashboardScreen.kt (193KB) returned full dialog/nav maps without ever loading them into context - lossless, no crash, whole Layer-3+4 scan stayed well under limit.
